config.dragit.chat_width.name: Chat Image Max Width
config.dragit.chat_width.tooltip:
The maximum rendering width of chat images in pixels. 
Images are scaled proportionally, so this does not stretch or distort them.
config.dragit.chat_height.name: Chat Image Max Height
config.dragit.chat_height.tooltip:
The maximum rendering height of chat images in pixels. 
Images are scaled proportionally, so this does not stretch or distort them.
config.dragit.chat_pixels.name: Chat Image Max Pixels
config.dragit.chat_pixels.tooltip:
The maximum renderable pixels of chat images. 
Images would be compressed and lose details if you decrease this value. 
Performance impact is mainly about network sync, not client rendering.
config.dragit.painting_pixels.name: Painting Image Max Pixels

paper.dragit.guide: Right Click To Show DragIt Usage Note
guide.dragit.skin: Custom skin: switch to first-person view -> open inventory -> drag in an image -> done.
guide.dragit.cape: Custom cape: switch to third-person view -> open inventory -> drag in an image -> done. Vanilla cape format is not supported yet; it must be a regular image.
guide.dragit.chat: Send images in chat: open the chat box -> drag in an image -> done.
guide.dragit.item_frame: Custom item frame display: build an item frame wall of at least 4×4 -> aim the crosshair at one item frame (or need to be a corner item frame if you want to drag a video) -> drag in an image -> done.
guide.dragit.painting: Custom painting: place a painting -> aim the crosshair at it -> drag in an image -> done.
guide.dragit.naruto_loading: NarutoLoading integration: drag a video onto the title screen to directly change the current background; item frames and capes can also accept videos instead of being limited to images.
guide.dragit.naruto_loading.note: Videos are only visible locally. For multiplayer synchronization, other players must have the same video file at the same relative path.
